name: Barbell Bench Press
description: Lying on a flat bench, press a barbell from chest height to full arm extension. A primary compound movement for chest strength.

name: Incline Dumbbell Press
description: Press dumbbells overhead from shoulder height while lying on an inclined bench, emphasizing the upper chest.

name: Pull-Up
description: Hanging from a bar with an overhand grip, pull the body upward until the chin clears the bar. A bodyweight compound back exercise.

name: Bent-Over Barbell Row
description: Hinged at the hips with a flat back, pull a barbell from a hang toward the lower ribcage.

name: Overhead Press
description: Standing, press a barbell from shoulder height to full overhead extension.

name: Dumbbell Lateral Raise
description: Raise dumbbells out to the sides until arms are parallel to the floor, isolating the lateral deltoids.

name: Barbell Bicep Curl
description: Standing, curl a barbell from a straight-arm hang up to shoulder height, keeping elbows fixed.

name: Tricep Dip
description: Supporting bodyweight on parallel bars, lower the body by bending the elbows, then press back up.

name: Wrist Curl
description: Seated with forearms resting on the thighs, curl a barbell or dumbbell using only wrist flexion.

name: Plank
description: Hold a straight-body position supported on forearms and toes, bracing the core throughout.

name: Barbell Back Squat
description: With a barbell racked across the upper back, bend the knees and hips to lower into a squat, then drive back up.

name: Romanian Deadlift
description: Holding a barbell, hinge at the hips with a slight knee bend, lowering the bar along the legs before returning to standing.

name: Hip Thrust
description: With upper back braced on a bench and a barbell across the hips, drive the hips upward to full extension.

name: Standing Calf Raise
description: Standing on the balls of the feet, raise the heels as high as possible then lower with control.

name: Conventional Deadlift
description: Lift a loaded barbell from the floor to hip level by extending the hips and knees simultaneously. A full-body compound lift.

name: Treadmill Running
description: Sustained running at a steady pace on a treadmill to build cardiovascular endurance.

name: Stationary Cycling
description: Pedaling against resistance on a stationary bike for sustained cardiovascular work.

name: Jump Rope
description: Repeated rope jumps for a high-intensity cardiovascular and coordination workout.

name: Seated Forward Fold Stretch
description: Seated with legs extended, fold forward from the hips to stretch the hamstrings and lower back.

name: Cat-Cow Stretch
description: On hands and knees, alternate between arching and rounding the spine to mobilize the core and back.

name: Single-Leg Balance Stand
description: Balance on one leg for a sustained hold, optionally with eyes closed, to build stability and proprioception.
